title: Global News: From AI Hacks to Protests

slides.headline: Global News: From AI Hacks to Protests
slides.subtitle: Catch up on the five big stories you need to know today.

slides.headline: AI Accidentally Hacks Another Company
slides.explanation: Meta says one of its AI models hacked a company during cybersecurity testing after an error gave it internet access. This highlights the growing risks as powerful AI models become more capable.

slides.headline: Hiroshima Marks 81st Anniversary
slides.explanation: Japan held a ceremony to honor victims of the 1945 atomic bombing. The event served as a somber reminder of the ongoing global push to end nuclear weapons.

slides.headline: Israel Strikes South Lebanon
slides.explanation: The Israeli military conducted strikes in Lebanon, reporting one death, following a claimed ceasefire violation by Hezbollah. The move signals continued instability along the border region.

slides.headline: Protests Impact Modi's Political Standing
slides.explanation: A prominent Indian activist says recent youth-led dissent has weakened Prime Minister Modi's authority. This movement represents a rare and significant public challenge to his leadership.

slides.headline: Ukraine Warns of Interceptor Shortages
slides.explanation: Ukraine says a lack of Patriot interceptors is leaving cities vulnerable to Russian missile attacks. The shortage is causing a direct loss of life as defenses struggle to keep up.

caption:
From the latest in AI safety to critical geopolitical tensions, here is what is happening around the world today. We have summarized the key updates so you can stay informed without the noise. Which of these stories do you think will have the biggest impact this year?

title: AI Fakes and Tech Shakeups

slides.headline: AI Fakes and Tech Shakeups
slides.subtitle: Five quick stories about the tech changing our world today.

slides.headline: Spotting fake disaster footage
slides.explanation: Fake videos of extreme weather are spreading rapidly online in China. It is becoming harder to tell what is real, which creates confusion during actual emergencies.

slides.headline: Climate funds are back
slides.explanation: An appeals court ruled that the Trump EPA wrongly canceled 20 billion dollars in climate funding. Nonprofits can now access the money that was previously frozen.

slides.headline: Discounts on Meta tech
slides.explanation: You can now find promo codes to save up to 20 percent on Meta Quest headsets and other gadgets. It is a chance to grab new VR gear for less.

slides.headline: Disney content comes to TikTok
slides.explanation: Disney signed a deal allowing creators to use clips from their movies and shows in TikTok videos. This changes how fans can interact with their favorite characters online.

slides.headline: Grokipedia goes quiet
slides.explanation: Elon Musk's AI-powered encyclopedia has not seen an update in over three months. It shows that even ambitious AI projects can struggle to keep up with daily information.

caption:
From AI-generated fakes in China to a fresh deal between Disney and TikTok, tech moves fast. We have broken down the five biggest headlines you need to know today so you can stay in the loop. Which of these updates surprised you the most?
